text:
Nadia: FYI spun a 4% canary of v7-quant4-longdoc this morning. Early A/B shows a focused rerank MRR drop on >2k tokens (~-10%) and p95 latency +25ms. No hallucination uptick.

Rohan: throwing the quick numbers in:
```
slice=longdoc_top10
vbaseline=v6.0-fp16: rerank_mrr=0.446
v7-quant4: rerank_mrr=0.401
delta=-0.045 (-10.1%)
latency.p95: 165ms -> 190ms
kv_warmup_miss_rate: 0.7% -> 2.0%
```
Signals spike when kv_warmup_count < 8.

Priya: our canary auto-fallbacks are currently mrr_drop 8% and halluc_abs 2%. For longdocs we should tighten and add a composite gate with token-level variance. Proposal: abort if any of these triggers within a 10m window: mrr_drop_pct > 5% OR latency_p95_ms_increase > 20ms OR kv_warmup_miss_rate_pct > 1% OR token_logit_std_rel_increase > 20%.

Nadia: +1. Also suggest a preflight synthetic warmup job (200 real longdocs) run against the canary pool before any ramp >1%. That would catch cold-kv effects early.

Rohan: short-term mitigation: I'll apply a route override for the canary pool setting kv_warmup=12 so caches warm before scoring. Opening CL now.

Priya: I'll patch the rollout config to include the composite gate and the new thresholds. Snippet applied to staging rollout yaml.

infra-bot: Route override deployed to canary pool: kv_warmup=12 (change-id: change-7821).

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-2098 opened: "v7-quant4 longdoc rerank regression (canary)". Watchers: eng-ml, eng-platform, dev-sre.

Nadia: Plan: 1) enforce stricter auto-fallback (Priya), 2) shrink live canary to 1% until synthetic warmup finishes, 3) run warmed shadow with kv_warmup=12 and collect token_logit_std + kernel traces, 4) decide rollback vs rebaseline. Tagging @dev-sre for warmup runner. :white_check_mark:
